methods.track_to_track: target track copper (centreline buffered by width/2) to neighbour track copper, same layer
methods.track_to_copper: target track copper to all of the neighbour's same-layer copper (tracks, pads, vias, fills)
methods.all_copper: tracks + pads + via annular rings (+ the neighbour's same-layer zone fills), same layer, edge to edge
methods.plan_view: target copper on one layer to neighbour copper on another layer, edge to edge in plan view; zone fills on other layers are reference planes, not neighbours; separation = dielectric between
methods.coupled: mm of the target's track centrelines within the radius (edge to edge) of the neighbour's same-layer copper
methods.radius: max of the target's and the neighbour's class radius (board config neighbour_radii_mm)
methods.reference_raw: track centreline over the zone fills of the adjacent copper layer; fill holes count as no copper
methods.reference_antipads_excl: as raw, but fill holes that contain a drilled hole (via, PTH, NPTH) count as copper
methods.bodies: track centreline inside a footprint body polygon (courtyard, else fab, else pads), plan view
